implementation.persistence: SessionStore.bind registers a synchronous observer independently of the UI event sink. Tool intent is fsynced before execution; receipt snapshot is committed before the completed journal marker.
implementation.recovery: Unresolved intents become unknown ledger records with preserved IDs and input hashes. Same-ID replay returns the unknown receipt without executing. Existing committed receipts are preserved. New session IDs isolate previous journal entries.
implementation.ownership: CLI resume switches the shared active store path and output binding. SDK forks retain source snapshot and independent output storage. No-autosave installs no persistence observer.
